name: Shira Yamano
source:
The main protagonist of Arc I.

While working to better himself from confusion of a past he cannot understand, he created the Comfy Club alongside Loui to relax and further himself away from his trauma. He has trouble being able to understand a mysterious past, and now he seems to be caught up in a chain of events that raises more questions than answers.
translation:
The main protagonist of Arc I.

While working to better himself from confusion of a past he cannot understand, he created the Comfy Club alongside Loui to relax and further himself away from his trauma. He has trouble being able to understand a mysterious past, and now he seems to be caught up in a chain of events that raises more questions than answers.
